Alex / Sophie —

Thanks for the clarifications, that helps a lot. A few confirmations from our side to address your items and unblock kickoff: 

- Encryption: Redwood encrypts all customer data in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest using AES-256. For hosted customers we manage keys via our KMS; for customers with PHI we recommend Redwood Private or Dedicated with customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) so you retain control of DEK/KEK.
- Audit logs: application and access logs can be exported to your SIEM (we support S3 export or direct forwarders). Retention is configurable per-account; typical default is 90 days.
- BAA: Redwood can execute a BAA for customers handling PHI; our legal team requires a short intake and NDA for SOC 2 report access. I’ve linked the DocuSign request below for initial legal intake.
- SOC 2: We maintain SOC 2 Type II controls; the current report is available under NDA.

Proposed kickoff: Wed 17 Jun 2026, 10:00am PT — that slot works for our team as well. I’ll send a calendar invite after you confirm.

To help speed review I uploaded our response template and a short intake doc here: https://drive.google.com/fake/medora-questionnaire (contains Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_Response_Template.xlsx and a network diagram example). I’ve also added the HubSpot record for this opportunity (HS-59241).

Systems we’ll include in the initial review (confirm/modify):
- Redwood API endpoints used by Medora (auth patterns, rate limits)
- Any Dedicated/Private deployment components (if you choose Private for PHI)
- Authentication (SAML/OIDC) and SCIM provisioning points
- Data retention/export paths and where logs are stored
- Integration points with your analytics pipeline (how de-id/PHI flows into our processing)

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_Response_Template.xlsx, Network_Diagram.png

Let me know if you want our security engineer on the kickoff (I can loop in Chris Wu for technical deep-dive).

Best,
